headline: Drones strike Russian Baltic port of Ust-Luga
summary: Dozens of long-range drones attacked the Russian Baltic port of Ust-Luga overnight, causing explosions near the strategic export facility. The Russian Defense Ministry claimed to have intercepted 275 drones across 12 regions.
why: Ust-Luga is a critical export hub for Russian energy and commodities. Attacks on such infrastructure can disrupt supply chains and impact global energy prices.
why_moved: Geopolitical risk in major energy-producing regions typically drives up commodity prices due to supply disruption fears.
